notes: Note the strong masculine declension: genitive des Berges, plural die Berge.
Do not confuse with die Burg, which means a castle or fortress.

senses.definition: A very high natural elevation of the earth's surface, higher than a hill.

examples.text: Im Winter steigen wir auf diesen Berg, um Ski zu fahren.
examples.translation: In winter we climb this mountain to go skiing.
examples.emotion: excited and energetic, looking forward to the outdoor sport

senses.definition: A large pile or heap of things.

examples.text: Auf dem Schreibtisch liegt ein großer Berg von Papier.
examples.translation: There is a big pile of paper on the desk.
examples.emotion: overwhelmed and slightly annoyed by the amount of work to do

definitions: A very high natural elevation of the earth's surface, higher than a hill.
